title: Étale lifting of a finite free quotient projector
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring, $I\subseteq A$ an ideal, $n\geq0$, and $\bar p$ an idempotent endomorphism of $(A/I)^n$. There exist an étale ring map $g:A\to A\prime$ [def-weil-etale-morphism], an isomorphism $\alpha:A/I\xrightarrow\sim A\prime/IA\prime$ with $\alpha(a\bmod I)=g(a)\bmod IA\prime$, and an idempotent endomorphism $p\prime$ of $(A\prime)^n$ whose standard matrix, reduced modulo $IA\prime$, equals the entrywise image under $\alpha$ of the standard matrix of $\bar p$.

source.place: Tag 07M5, proof: Étale lifting of a finite free quotient projector

proof.text: Apply the integral-model theorem to the given finite free quotient projector. Obtain integral B, ψ:B → Mat_n(A), and y whose quotient class is idempotent and whose reduced matrix is the projector matrix.

Apply exists_etale_lift_isIdempotentElem (Tag 07M4) to y mod IB. Obtain the étale A → C, quotient isomorphism α with its compatibility on A, an idempotent e in T=B ⊗_A C, and β:B/IB ≃ T/IT satisfying β(y mod IB)=e mod IT and β(b mod IB)=b⊗1 mod IT.

Extend ψ entrywise to ψC:B → Mat_n(C). Scalar matrices commute with ψC(B), so Algebra.TensorProduct.lift gives Ψ:T → Mat_n(C), Ψ(b⊗c)=ψC(b)*scalar(c). Reduction q:Mat_n(C) → Mat_n(C/IC) sends Ψ(algebraMap a) to zero for a in I, because g(a) belongs to IC. Hence q∘Ψ factors through T/IT by Ideal.Quotient.lift. Apply this factorization to the equality β(y mod IB)=e mod IT. The formula for β gives q(Ψ e)=q(ψC y). Entrywise compatibility of α and g then identifies this last matrix with the matrix of the original quotient projector mapped by α.

Set p′=Matrix.toLinAlgEquiv′(Ψ e). Both maps preserve idempotency. The inverse matrix equivalence gives toMatrix′(p′)=Ψ e, and the preceding equality is exactly the required reduction. Retain the étale map and α from Tag 07M4.

lean.statement: theorem exists_etale_lift_finite_free_projector (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (I : Ideal A) (n : ℕ) (pbar : Module.End (A ⧸ I) (Fin n → A ⧸ I)) (hpbar : IsIdempotentElem pbar) : ∃ (A' : CommRingCat.{u}) (g : CommRingCat.of A ⟶ A'), letI : Algebra A A' := g.hom.toAlgebra; Etale (Spec.map g) ∧ ∃ α : A ⧸ I ≃+* A' ⧸ I.map (algebraMap A A'), (∀ a : A, α (Ideal.Quotient.mk I a) = Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (algebraMap A A' a)) ∧ ∃ p' : Module.End A' (Fin n → A'), IsIdempotentElem p' ∧ (LinearMap.toMatrix' p').map (Ideal.Quotient.mk _) = (LinearMap.toMatrix' pbar).map α.toRingHom
